'''Quilken''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Quilken system/Legends|Quilken system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AOC" /> After [[Mungo Baobab]], heir of the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]] and [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren Yomm]], a girl from the planet [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] got married, the couple settled on Quilken. They found new sources of roonstones on the planet and set up facilities to process it. The also opened the [[Club Baobab]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] for visitors to the nearby [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]]. The security of the facilities was increased to guard the precious gems. Mungo was busy arranging roonstone shipments to planet [[Sim'char'ser]] and other Outer Rim worlds.<ref name="idiot" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of the floating [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and a friend of Baobab arrived to Quilken. He was chased by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Thune (bounty hunter)|Thune]], who was hired by the former owner of Cloud City, [[Dominic Raynor]]. Raynor lost the [[City/Legends|settlement]] in a match of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card game against Calrissian. Calrissian set up a trap for Thune in the Club Baobab.<ref name="idiot" />
